Name: Mouse-Ear Cress
Description:
[font=Courier New]﻿The mouse-ear cress, or ﻿[i]arabidopsis thaliana, [/i]is a small flowering plant that grows well on rocky, sandy terrain. It is used as a model organism in genetics, and was the first plant to have its entire genome sequenced.[/font]

This mod simply adds one flower crop to the game using Content Patcher. Seeds are available from Robin for 80g (Demetrius maintains a few strains in his lab, and has his wife sell the seeds he collects from them). It takes 6 days to grow in spring, summer, or fall, and produces 1-2 flowers and 1-2 seeds on harvest. Each flower sells for 100g. It is not used in any recipes.

This flower is not very expensive or useful, it's just something pretty to look at :-)

The flower pot mod shown in the image is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4363]Terracotta Garden Pots[/url]﻿.

Install instructions:
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Spacecore[/url]
- Download the file from this mod and drag the folder inside the .zip to your \Stardew Valley\Mods folder
- Run the game using SMAPI.

Thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/76474198]asqwedcxz741[/url]﻿ for the Simplified Chinese translation and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48693548]jina2ya[/url]﻿ for the Korean translation!
